name: GLM 4.7 Flash
short: Z.ai's 30B-A3B MoE lightweight model with 1M context, MIT license, and balanced performance for agentic workflows.
pricingNote: Free on Zen; no Free tier is required
standout: MIT-licensed 30B MoE with competitive benchmark scores in the 30B class and a generous 1M context window, offering an open-weights alternative in the mid-tier space.
tradeoff: Open-source MIT license contrasts with Z.ai's custom license for flagship GLM-5.3; Flash variant is designed for efficiency, not for top-tier closed-model reasoning at scale.
